title: Graduate Research Assistant
company: Data and Image Analysis Group (DIAG) Lab

duties.text: Developing ML models to predict the Time-to-conversion for Cancer patients and scripts to analyze over 12500+ Medical CT scans on Compute Canada supercomputer cluster using Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Bash, and Shell scripting.
Optimizing scripts of research experiments for 2+ TBs of medical 3D CT scans using Python multithreading and batch processing to reduce the runtime of each by 60+ minutes on average.
Analyzing experiment results and calculations and writing 2+ research publications using NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib, LaTeX and Scikit-learn.

Led the full stack development and maintenance of the MyAlice e-commerce help desk using Python, TypeScript, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes to help businesses gain up to 35% more orders from their customers.
Built the Shopify module from the scratch using Django, React within 1 sprint to support 300+ new e-commerces.
Promoted to Software Engineer L2 from Software Engineer L1 within 6 months of joining; Awarded as the Best performer of Q4 2021.
Increased reliability by converting internal e-commerce API calls to GraphQL; reduced the errors reported by AWS Cloudwatch by 40%.
Optimized the performance of the e-commerce front-end by rewriting 35+ Redux state management calls.
Enhanced the Django unit test coverage by 70% and setup unit testing during stage deployment using Github Actions CI/CD.

Led the feature development and maintenance of MYNKG FIS and Bloom Kenya Android apps using Android SDK, Java, Kotlin, MongoDB Realm to remotely support 2000+ coffee producing farmers in rural areas of Honduras and Kenya.

Spearheaded the R&D effort to optimize memory usage, disk usage, database queries, codebase structures, MVVM design patterns, and quality of life improvements to increase the performance of 10 products on lower-end Android devices.
Promoted to Software Engineer from Junior Software Engineer with excellent performance reviews.

Designed APIs and implemented an on-demand syncing module using reactive programming (RxJava) multithreaded workflows to enable features that work in areas without mobile data to support 10000+ small business owners.
Reduced memory leaks by 95% by optimizing legacy codes and resource usage with the help of Android Debug Tools and Resource monitors.
Mentored 2 intern engineers and received exceptional feedback on teamwork and leadership.
